snippet.textDisplay: I watch these videos on your journey with your Mother and I admire your dedication commitment and the bond and bravery not of the Dementia you’re showing but respect for the Love and Kindness of the both of you nobody can judge you for what you’re doing I wouldn’t entertain them in acknowledgment so many people want to judge and comment negatively but I watch your videos on kindness caring and loving I have a Aunt who’s 84 years young and she has dementia I see her in her memory care and she’s very much in some ways like your mother it’s very emotional and extremely exhausting knowing her life has changed dramatically she is the only living relative I have left in my life she looks at me and calls me my mother’s name that’s how she sees me and I never ever correct her especially considering how close they were together I hope 🤞🏼 that one day they will have a Cure for this horrible disease but until then life goes on and will continue to grow and comfort our loved ones as if it is the same days and nights and give them unconditional love and support ❤ God Bless you and your Mother!!
